name: Actual Budget
description: Privacy-first personal finance — track spending, manage budgets, and view financial reports
author: Crow

env_vars.name: ACTUAL_PASSWORD
env_vars.description: Password of an Actual server you already run elsewhere. Leave it empty for the Actual server Crow installs on this machine: Crow generates that one's password.

env_vars.name: ACTUAL_SERVER_PASSWORD
env_vars.description: Password of the Actual server Crow installs on this machine. Crow generates it, saves it in Settings → Passwords (this machine only) and sets it on the new server right after install. Log in to Actual with it.

env_vars.name: ACTUAL_SYNC_ID
env_vars.description: Budget sync ID to auto-select budget

notes: Privacy-first budgeting. Data stays local. Crow sets a generated password on the Actual server it installs (Settings → Passwords). To use an Actual server you already run, set ACTUAL_URL and ACTUAL_PASSWORD instead.
